    if img.ndim==2:

    return np.stack([map_coordinates(img[...,j],[y,x],order=1,mode='nearest') for j in range(img.shape[-1])],axis=-1)

def arm_delta(x,y,dx,dy,twist):
    # Anchored, gently bending forearm, followed by a small wrist roll.
    s=np.clip(((x-215)*(-43)+(y-151)*(-70))/(43**2+70**2),0,1.08)
    w=s*s*(3-2*s)
    wrist=np.clip((s-.64)/.36,0,1)
    a=twist*wrist
    vx=x-172;vy=y-81
    return dx*w+(np.cos(a)-1)*vx-np.sin(a)*vy, dy*w+np.sin(a)*vx+(np.cos(a)-1)*vy

def warp_arm(dx,dy,twist):
    sx=X.copy();sy=Y.copy()
    for j in range(13):
        ax,ay=arm_delta(sx,sy,dx,dy,twist)
        sx=X-ax;sy=Y-ay
    mask=sample(arm,sx,sy)
    tex=sample(I,sx,sy)
    return tex,mask

# High-resolution geometry supplies antialiased steel edges; photographic layers
# remain sampled from the source at their true resolution.
def utensil(center,grip,turn,opacity):
    S=4
    rgba=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S),(0,0,0,0));d=ImageDraw.Draw(rgba)
    center=np.array(center);grip=np.array(grip)
    v=grip-center;v=v/max(np.linalg.norm(v),1)
    n=np.array([-v[1],v[0]])
    width=5.9*(.57+.43*abs(np.cos(turn)))
    def xy(p):return tuple(np.round(np.array(p)*S).astype(int))
    def poly(points,col):d.polygon([xy(p) for p in points],fill=col)
    # Black heatproof handle, a bright edge, and a slender neck.
    a=center+v*6;b=grip+v*10
    poly([a-n*1.4,a+n*1.4,b+n*1.6,b-n*1.6],(112,115,109,255))
    d.line([xy(a-n*.65),xy(b-n*.65)],fill=(180,181,161,255),width=3)
    a=grip-v*3;b=grip+v*14
    poly([a-n*2.1,a+n*2.1,b+n*2.45,b-n*2.45],(34,32,25,255))
    d.line([xy(a-n*1.5),xy(b-n*1.5)],fill=(67,63,48,255),width=3)
    tip=center-v*7;heel=center+v*6
    poly([tip-n*width*.86,tip+n*width*.86,center+v*3+n*width,
          heel+n*3,heel-n*3,center+v*3-n*width],(119,121,104,255))
    d.line([xy(tip-n*width*.86),xy(tip+n*width*.86)],fill=(203,194,155,255),width=3)
    # Slots show the dark cooking surface.
    for off in [-.52,0,.52]:
        a=center-v*4+n*width*off;b=center+v*3+n*width*off
        d.line([xy(a),xy(b)],fill=(41,35,22,255),width=5)
        d.line([xy(a+n*.35),xy(b+n*.35)],fill=(167,164,138,255),width=2)
    ar=np.array(rgba.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS),float)
    return ar[...,:3],ar[...,3]/255*opacity

def food_layer(cx,cy,angle,roll):
    # Project a thin irregular slab rotating around its long axis.
    # Its side remains visible even in the edge-on frame.
    c=np.cos(angle);s=np.sin(angle)
    scale=np.sqrt(c*c+.025*s*s)
    rotation=np.array([[np.cos(roll),-np.sin(roll)],[np.sin(roll),np.cos(roll)]])
    dx=X-cx;dy=Y-cy
    qx=rotation[0,0]*dx+rotation[1,0]*dy
    qy=rotation[0,1]*dx+rotation[1,1]*dy
    mirror=1 if c>=0 else -1
    sx=129+qx/(scale*mirror)
    sy=76+qy-.115*s*qx
    m=sample(food,sx,sy)
    tex=sample(food_tex if c>=0 else back_tex,sx,sy)
    # Lit top and browned edge. The edge inherits the original food's texture.
    light=.91+.09*abs(c)
    tex*=light
    edgeoff=1.65+1.55*abs(s)
    side_mask=sample(food,sx,sy-edgeoff)
    side_tex=sample(food_tex,sx,sy-edgeoff)*np.array([.63,.57,.5])
    return tex,m,side_tex,side_mask

def render(t):
    dx,dy,cx,cy,angle,roll,bx,by,twist=pose(t)
    frame=clean.copy()
    # Breathing oil shimmer confined to the pan; never changes the kitchen geometry.
    sh=np.sin(X*.7+Y*.41+t*1.45)*.55
    inside=np.exp(-(((X-129)/25)**4+((Y-77)/22)**4))
    frame+=sh[...,None]*inside[...,None]*np.array([1,.7,.3])
    hand_tex,hand_alpha=warp_arm(dx,dy,twist)
    gx,gy=arm_delta(np.array(168.),np.array(77.),dx,dy,twist)
    grip=(168+float(gx),77+float(gy))
    ut,um=utensil((bx,by),grip,angle,min(1,t/2))
    # Contact shadows become broader and lighter as the food rises.
    lift=max(0,76-cy)
    ft,fm,st,sm=food_layer(cx,cy,angle,roll)
    shadow=gaussian_filter(sample(np.maximum(fm,sm),X-1.4,Y-lift*.50-2),1.0+lift*.075)
    shadow*=np.exp(-(((X-130)/30)**6+((Y-77)/26)**6))
    frame*=1-shadow[...,None]*(.23 if lift>2 else .31)
    toolshadow=gaussian_filter(sample(um,X-1,Y-2),1)
    frame*=1-toolshadow[...,None]*.17
    frame=over(frame,ut,um)
    frame=over(frame,st,sm)
    frame=over(frame,ft,fm)
    # Arm shadow remains soft, and the real hand occludes the handle at the grip.
    hs=gaussian_filter(sample(hand_alpha,X-1.7,Y-2.3),1.65)
    frame*=1-hs[...,None]*.115
    frame=over(frame,hand_tex,hand_alpha)
    # Very subtle egocentric lean towards the pan and a wrist-action recoil.
    amount=np.sin(np.pi*min(t,19)/23)**2
    zoom=1+.013*amount
    camx=.75*amount+.23*np.sin(t*.54)*min(t/3,1)
    camy=-.6*amount+.27*np.sin(t*.42)*min(t/3,1)
    frame=sample(frame,(X-128)/zoom+128+camx,(Y-77)/zoom+77+camy)
    return np.clip(frame,0,255)


def main():
    frames=[SOURCE.copy()]
    for i in range(1,20):
        # Subframe shutter integration softens only actual motion, not static details.
        if 8<=i<=14:
            out=(render(i-.09)+2*render(i)+render(i+.09))/4
        else:

    print('Frame differences:',np.round(np.abs(np.diff(frames.astype(float),axis=0)).mean((1,2,3)),3).tolist())
